frontmatter.sidebar_description: Delete a user and remove the association to its auth identity.

blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `removeUserAccountWorkflow`. It belongs to the `@arcangel/arcangel/core-flows` package.

This workflow deletes a user and remove the association to its auth identity. It's used
by the [Delete User Admin API Route](https://docs.arcangel.com/api/admin/users/delete-a-user).

You can use this workflow within your customizations or your own custom workflows, allowing you to
delete users within your custom flows.

steps.name: setAuthAppMetadataStep
steps.description:
This step sets the `app_metadata` property of an auth identity. This is useful to
associate a user (whether it's an admin user or customer) with an auth identity
that allows them to authenticate into Arcangel.

You can learn more about auth identites in
[this documentation](https://docs.arcangel.com/resources/commerce-modules/auth/auth-identity-and-actor-types).

To use this for a custom actor type, check out [this guide](https://docs.arcangel.com/resources/commerce-modules/auth/create-actor-type)
that explains how to create a custom `manager` actor type and manage its users.

steps.name: deleteAuthIdentityStep
steps.description: This step deletes one or more auth identities.
